articles.title_en: Twelve years later, we’re still making trouble. An anniversary note about exile, censorship, and the next birthday we hope to reach
articles.lead_en: On October 20, 2014, Meduza went live from Riga. Earlier that year, Russia illegally annexed Crimea, and our co-founder Galina Timchenko was fired as editor-in-chief of the popular news portal Lenta.ru, prompting mass resignations in the newsroom.

articles.title_en: Ukrainian drones strike Russia’s Tambov region, reportedly hitting infrastructure on Druzhba oil pipeline
articles.lead_en: Ukrainian drones struck Russia’s Tambov region overnight on October 20, sparking a fire at one of the facilities, the region’s governor, Yevgeny Pervyshev, said. He declined to elaborate, saying only that no one was injured.
